trigger: User opportunity-first steering received after primary, C5 and economic studies began; none is retroactively called opportunity-led discovery.

budget.selection_rule: Compare beneficiary consequence, source-evidenced gap against real alternatives, purpose-preserving testability, plausible commercial arrangement, reusable instrument and falsifiability. No guaranteed flagship acceptance. Stop or redirect if all fail.

constraints: No benchmark selected for convenient code
No large new simulator before opportunity dossier and documented selection
Preserve all completed studies, frozen methods, outcomes and corrected drafts
Conventional comparators may use discovered structure
No real sales or counterparties inferred from sources
Actual cost and token telemetry unavailable; modeled amounts labeled
